summary: A dedicated 42-site RV park (drive-in and back-in lots, electric + water hookups, dump station) sold by the night at $35, May 1 - Nov 30 (season now manual), reservation required by phone 1-877-475-7375 (the RV park's own line, matches the entry), register at the hotel desk. Confirmed $35 (2026 page). Not stated by the operator: amperage, sewer (false, derived, left), pull-through (derived, left), laundry (derived, left), Good Sam.
